findings: COMMAND_BATCH visibility is correct: shown only when web.serverRelativeUrl starts with /sites/DMS/Finance (case-insensitive) AND (>=2 selected PDFs OR exactly one selected folder); hidden for a single PDF and anywhere outside Finance. COMMAND_1/2/3 logic is in a separate untouched block and is unchanged. onExecute expands folders to PDFs, dedupes, alerts on zero PDFs, and redirects with fileRefs=encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(string[])) plus source.

createProcessForDocument is the single shared routine for both flows. With batch undefined the LIST_PROCESS payload (Title, HashHex, FileRef0, RequestorId, Status, ProcessData, UserNotif, isDownloadable) is byte-for-byte identical to the original single save on main; BatchId/BatchMode are stamped only when batch is provided. handleSaveWorkflow (single) resolves currentUser.Id once and calls the helper with no batch.

Batch path writes one shared BatchId (generateBatchId: crypto.randomUUID with a getRandomValues v4 fallback) and BatchMode='AllOrNothing' on every item. Per-document validation (loaded, >=1 approver, every approver has >=1 box) blocks submit and jumps to the offending doc. Mid-loop creation failure surfaces a clear message and stops without deleting already-created items (distributed rollback documented as out of scope).

_submitReject performs the reject updates first (Status=Rejected, hash, activity log) then calls _cancelBatchSiblings. The sibling routine is fully wrapped in try/catch with an inner try/catch around the BatchId/BatchMode read so missing columns log a warning and return without throwing; it only proceeds when BatchMode==='AllOrNothing' and BatchId is non-empty, so non-batch rejects behave exactly as before.

_cancelBatchSiblings cancels only siblings with Status eq 'Processing' (Approved/Rejected/Canceled are never queried), excludes the rejected process by Id, sets Notes beginning exactly with 'System Canceled:' (matches SYSTEM_CANCEL_PREFIX='System Canceled:' with indexOf===0 detection in EsignDataService), cancels each sibling's Pending tasks, and escapes single quotes in the OData filter. Per-sibling and per-task errors are isolated.

No email-sending code and no column provisioning were added; a comment notes Power Automate fires initiate emails on item-created in LIST_PROCESS. InitiateEsignForm diff is scoped to the LIST_TASKS import and the reject-side batch block; the approve flow is untouched.

npm run build (heft build --clean) exits 0 with no TypeScript/ESLint errors. The 7 lint warnings are all pre-existing in files not touched by this feature (ApprovalService.ts, EsignDataService.ts x3, UserService.ts, Sidebar.tsx x2).
